question: Does addressing this review feedback require changing the extension's code? Answer code when the response needs a change under src/ or to how the extension behaves, which hands the work back to develop. Answer metadata-only when the response is limited to Store metadata, screenshots, README, CHANGELOG or a reply, with no code change.
